run_clip_text_features: run the script to extract CLIP text features from LVIS category names and save to numpy file
run_bert_text_features: run the script with --model bert to extract BERT text embeddings from category annotations
run_roberta_text_features: run the script with --model roberta to extract RoBERTa text embeddings from category annotations
run_avg_synonyms: run the script with --avg_synonyms to average CLIP features across WordNet synonyms per category
run_custom_prompt: run the script with --prompt photo or scene to use custom prompt templates for text features
